free_tier.stated: No published per-user or per-file quota anywhere in the docs. The platform hosts the files itself ('upload the data file directly to the HDX platform'), S3-backed. Aggregate catalog is 28,359 datasets and growing at organisational pace.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: extraction found no retention clause; the seed's limits text may still state one, see extras.limits_verbatim

egress.terms: Unmetered public download. Direct GET on /dataset/<slug>/resource/<id>/download/<file>; no egress counter, no rate card, no CDN token. Files are anonymous to read. No login to download.

interface_detail: CKAN 2.x action API (package_search / package_create / resource_create) plus the `hdx-python-api` wrapper, which is the documented write path.
tooling: curl + API token, or `pip install hdx-python-api`. Write operations need an API token from the user profile; token is per-user, free, issued on signup.
chaining: CKAN resource_create accepts a URL as well as a local file, so HDX can act as a metadata+mirror layer over another host. Public download URLs are stable and content-addressable by resource id. Reasonable as a serving tier.
limits_note: write-gated: you must belong to an HDX organisation with publishing rights. Any registered user may REQUEST a new organisation (`/org/request/new`) and the request is human-reviewed by OCHA. So the gate is editorial approval, not identity or payment.
reliability_note: UN-operated, 10+ years of uptime, but editorial review means a rejection is silent and unbounded. No SLA on org approval, and an org can be removed for content outside humanitarian scope. Do not treat as primary durable storage.
confidence_note: mechanically converted from the seed corpus; no page was read for this record in the storage-dossier pass. One page read moves it to documented.

extras.agent_focus: Government, municipal and public-sector hosting that accepts citizen deposits. Decisive axis: can an INDIVIDUAL (not an agency) publish, at what identity cost, at what per-file cap, and are published files anonymously retrievable afterwards. Probed CKAN write paths empirically (unauth organization_create, /user/register, owner_org distribution over 300-dataset samples) rather than trusting marketing copy.

binding_note: the write is a queue with a person or a rule in it, so the upload rate is set by somebody else
